58: newTalent{
59: 	name = "Keen Senses",
60: 	type = {"spell/divination", 2},
61: 	require = spells_req2,
62: 	mode = "sustained",
63: 	points = 5,
64: 	sustain_mana = 40,
65: 	tactical = { BUFF = 2 },
66: 	cooldown = 30,
67: 	getSeeInvisible = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentSpellDamage(t, 2, 45) end,
68: 	getSeeStealth = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentSpellDamage(t, 2, 20) end,
69: 	getCriticalChance = function(self, t) return self:combatTalentSpellDamage(t, 2, 12) end,
70: 	activate = function(self, t)
71: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/spell_generic")
72: 		return {
73: 			invis = self:addTemporaryValue("see_invisible", t.getSeeInvisible(self, t)),
74: 			stealth = self:addTemporaryValue("see_stealth", t.getSeeStealth(self, t)),
75: 			crit = self:addTemporaryValue("combat_spellcrit", t.getCriticalChance(self, t)),
76: 		}
77: 	end,
78: 	deactivate = function(self, t, p)
79: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("see_invisible", p.invis)
80: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("see_stealth", p.stealth)
81: 		self:removeTemporaryValue("combat_spellcrit", p.crit)
82: 		return true
83: 	end,
84: 	info = function(self, t)
85: 		local seeinvisible = t.getSeeInvisible(self, t)
86: 		local seestealth = t.getSeeStealth(self, t)
87: 		local criticalchance = t.getCriticalChance(self, t)
88: 		return ([[You focus your senses, getting information from moments in the future.
89: 		Improves your capacity to see invisible foes by +%d, to see through stealth by +%d, and to perform a critical spell cast by +%d%%.
90: 		The effects will improve with your Spellpower.]]):
91: 		tformat(seeinvisible, seestealth, criticalchance)
92: 	end,
93: }

85: newTalent{
86: 	name = "Frenzy",
87: 	type = {"cursed/slaughter", 2},
88: 	require = cursed_str_req2,
89: 	points = 5,
90: 	tactical = { ATTACKAREA = { PHYSICAL = 2 } },
91: 	is_melee = true,
92: 	random_ego = "attack",
93: 	cooldown = 12,
94: 	hate = 2,
95: 	getDamageMultiplier = function(self, t, hate)
96: 		return self:combatTalentIntervalDamage(t, "str", 0.25, 0.8, 0.4) * getHateMultiplier(self, 0.5, 1, false, hate)
97: 	end,
98: 	getDefenseChange = function(self, t)
99: 		return self:combatTalentIntervalDamage(t, "str", 6, 45)
100: 	end,
101: 	range = 0,
102: 	radius = 1,
103: 	target = function(self, t)
104: 		return {type="ball", range=self:getTalentRange(t), selffire=false, radius=self:getTalentRadius(t)}
105: 	end,
106: 	on_pre_use = function(self, t, silent) if not self:hasMHWeapon() then if not silent then game.logPlayer(self, "You require a mainhand weapon to use this talent.") end return false end return true end,
107: 	action = function(self, t)
108: 		local tg = self:getTalentTarget(t)
109: 
110: 		local targets = {}
111: 		self:project(tg, self.x, self.y, function(px, py, tg, self)
112: 			local target = game.level.map(px, py, Map.ACTOR)
113: 			if target and self:reactionToward(target) < 0 then
114: 				targets[#targets+1] = target
115: 			end
116: 		end)
117: 
118: 		if #targets <= 0 then return nil end
119: 
120: 		local damageMultiplier = t.getDamageMultiplier(self, t)
121: 		local defenseChange = t.getDefenseChange(self, t)
122: 
123: 		local effStalker = self:hasEffect(self.EFF_STALKER)
124: 		if effStalker and core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, effStalker.target.x, effStalker.target.y) > 1 then effStalker = nil end
125: 		for i = 1, 4 do
126: 			local target
127: 			if effStalker and not effStalker.target.dead then
128: 				target = effStalker.target
129: 			else
130: 				target = rng.table(targets)
131: 			end
132: 
133: 			-- We need to alter behavior slightly to accomodate shields since they aren't used in attackTarget
134: 			local shield, shield_combat = self:hasShield()
135: 			local weapon = self:hasMHWeapon() and self:hasMHWeapon().combat or self.combat
136: 			local hit = false
137: 			if not shield then
138: 				hit = self:attackTarget(target, nil, damageMultiplier, true)
139: 			else
140: 				hit = self:attackTargetWith(target, weapon, nil, damageMultiplier)
141: 				if self:attackTargetWith(target, shield_combat, nil, damageMultiplier) or hit then hit = true end
142: 			end
143: 
144: 			if hit and self:getTalentLevel(t) >= 3 and not target:hasEffect(target.EFF_OVERWHELMED) then
145: 				target:setEffect(target.EFF_OVERWHELMED, 4, {src=self, defenseChange=defenseChange})
146: 			end
147: 		end
148: 
149: 		return true
150: 	end,
151: 	info = function(self, t)
152: 		local defenseChange = t.getDefenseChange(self, t)
153: 		return ([[Assault nearby foes with 4 fast attacks for %d%% (at 0 Hate) to %d%% (at 100+ Hate) damage each. Stalked prey are always targeted if nearby.
154: 		At level 3 the intensity of your assault overwhelms anyone who is struck, reducing their Defense by %d for 4 turns.
155: 		The damage multiplier and Defense reduction increase with your Strength.
156: 
157: 		This talent will also attack with your shield, if you have one equipped.]]):tformat(t.getDamageMultiplier(self, t, 0) * 100, t.getDamageMultiplier(self, t, 100) * 100, -defenseChange)
158: 	end,
159: }
